name: mudge-tools
description: Safely use the Mudge CRM, read-only Brain, and published document factory from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: CRM, Brain, and Mudge documents in one connection
interface.longDescription: Mudge Tools connects Codex to the live family CRM through per-person OAuth. It supports bounded CRM reads and preview-confirm updates, permanently read-only Mudge Brain search, and private artifacts from the published Mudge document and native-form registry. It does not expose generic database access, repositories, filesystems, imports, deletes, uploads, or raw design source.
defaultPrompt: Find a CRM record and prepare a confirmed update
Create a Mudge document from a CRM property
